paper.title: Neural Sign Language Translation
paper.citation: Camgoz, Koller, Hadfield, and Bowden. 2018. Neural Sign Language Translation. CVPR, 7784-7793. DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2018.00812.

sources.role: Authors' model, train/evaluation entry point, README recipe, and BLEU implementation

status.numerical_agreement_basis: Both in-scope BLEU-4 targets were emitted by the published recipe and were reviewed as agreeing with the paper's integer-rounded values; the raw differences are +0.260990 and +0.603572.

datasets.name: RWTH-PHOENIX-Weather 2014T
datasets.version_or_subset: v3 original MP4 videos, direct frame-level S2T path
datasets.license_or_permission: The version-specific dataset page links CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; non-commercial project-cloud research processing. The generic RWTH database page currently names 4.0, so this record conservatively uses 3.0.
datasets.deviation: The upstream manifests point to MATLAB-resized 227x227 frame files. With the user's protocol approval, the retained simple-video-utils patch decodes the supplied MP4s at runtime and uses OpenCV cubic resize. RGB-to-BGR conversion matches the upstream OpenCV mean-subtraction convention, but this is not pixel-identical to the unpublished MATLAB resize plus image-file round trip.

metric_definitions.name: BLEU-4
metric_definitions.aggregation: Unsmoothened, case-sensitive, whitespace-tokenized corpus BLEU; the code prints orders 1-4 and returns order 4.

experiments.system: S2T with Luong attention, AlexNet fc7 features jointly trained from video frames, four 1000-unit residual GRU layers
experiments.checkpoint_rule: Authors' code saves the checkpoint with highest development BLEU-4 during training, then evaluates that saved best_bleu checkpoint on development and test after 150,000 steps.
experiments.paper_evidence: Table 5 S2T attention-mechanism experiments, Luong row. The upstream README command is the matching executable recipe; Table 6's Bahdanau system is not this target.

targets.paper_location: Table 5, S2T Attention Mechanism Experiments, Luong row, DEV BLEU-4

result.notes: Selected checkpoint 118000, evaluated by the upstream terminal best-model loop.

guesses: The paper does not state a seed; the authors' executable default uses seed 285, although its dropout operators are not globally seeded.
The paper describes convergence around 30 epochs and half-epoch evaluation; the pinned README/defaults instead define the concrete 150000-step, development-BLEU-selected executable recipe.
deviations: Direct MP4 decoding and OpenCV resize replaces unavailable upstream MATLAB-resized image files; this was an explicitly approved behavior-changing preprocessing deviation.
The initial 24-hour Modal segment ended at checkpoint 91000 and resumed with paired hparams/epoch state; no training restart occurred.
